extension.name: CB Profile Slim Display
extension.author: jaydenrussell
extension.license: GNU General Public License v2 or later
extension.description: Standalone Joomla module: displays the logged-in Community Builder user's display name and avatar in the top header navbar. Reads user data via the Community Builder API.

field.name: profile_url
field.label: Profile URL
field.description: Optional. Leave blank to hide the link (avatar/name is not clickable). Defaults to the current user's Community Builder profile.

field.name: avatar_base_path
field.label: Avatar Base Path
field.description: Directory (relative to site root) where Community Builder stores avatar files. Default matches a standard CB install. Only change if you relocated CB's image folder.

field.name: avatar_db_fallback
field.label: Avatar DB Fallback
field.description: OFF (default): avatar uses Community Builder API only. If CB returns no image, the avatar is blank — proving CB API is in use. ON: falls back to a direct #__comprofiler database query when CB API returns nothing.
